text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through every twist and turn of these 
pivotal three years, 
Daring Tact has run with all her might 
and delivered a truly magnificent 
performance.
choice_data_list:
(She's worked so hard every step of the 
way...)

(She's worked so hard every step of the 
way...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run relentlessly ever since her 
return from injury, 
she's currently resting to let her 
built-up fatigue heal. 
I'd like to find some way to treat her, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(Knock-knock-knock-knock... 
*RUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUMBLE*!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Morning!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's move! 
—To wherever the voice of destiny guides 
us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll explain while we run, 
so please just follow along...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, Epiphaneia came 
bursting 
into my room earlier and said—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact! Amazing work out there! 
You have tried sooooo, so very hard!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Let me reward you! No, I must! 
—Just as destiny commands!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—And so, that is how I ended up 
dashing out right behind Epiphaneia.
choice_data_list:
...Okay, got it! It's all about treating 
you, then!

...Okay, got it! It's all about treating 
you, then!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes— Ah, Epiphaneia is getting farther and 
farther ahead...! 
Let's catch up with her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Behold! The "Ultra-Syrup Boosted 
Hyper-Whipped Boba Miracle Mountain 
with Extra Honey and Light Ice"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: So this is the legendary...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was in my hometown, I saw TV 
features 
calling this the hottest big-city trend... 
I've always longed to try it just once.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I just wanted 
to introduce it to Daring Tact myself!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Daring Tact, listen closely. 
Here it comes... 3, 2, 1...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (*Chiiiiiime... Chiiiiiime...*)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... The sound of this pendulum 
clock... 
...It sounds just like the one I used to 
hear at the estate.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: How nostalgic...
choice_data_list:
(...Wait, this is actually turning out to 
be really relaxing.)

(...Wait, this is actually turning out to 
be really relaxing.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had braced myself for how chaotic 
Epiphaneia's 
whims would make our day, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every step of the way, it feels like she 
knows everything in advance, 
filling Daring Tact's heart with pure 
contentment.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Well, what did you think of that sky full 
of stars?! 
Shifting and turning like a kaleidoscope— 
absolutely breathtaking, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, deeply so! I was reunited with stars 
that can scarcely ever be seen in Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo's nights are way too bright, after 
all! 
Even so, Daring Tact...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Just because you can't see them doesn't 
mean they ever stopped twinkling. 
Your brilliance, too, ever since your 
debut... 
has never faded for a single moment!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Your star will keep on shining—now and 
forever. 
The voice of destiny says so itself!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You are incredible, Epiphaneia. 
It feels as though you understand 
everything I'm feeling inside...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I just want to understand, that's all! 
Because you are my blazing destiny and my 
ultimate joy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Thank you so much!
choice_data_list:
...By the way, why did you call me along 
too?

...By the way, why did you call me along 
too?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because I knew Daring Tact would have 
ten times as much fun if you were here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. 
Yes, that is—completely right♪
